title: RoadWatch corridor join ledger row
description: One candidate join between a federally-funded roadway project and a RoadWatch roadway segment. This is the derived link-candidate ledger (conceptually the AUTHORITATIVE_CORRIDOR_JOIN_LEDGER of the design brief), modelled on the legislative_fiscal_link_candidates ledger. Rows are manual-review candidates until promoted. All values are carried as strings in staging.

source_file.description: Path or name of the source artifact the join was derived from.

join_id.description: Deterministic id for the project<->segment candidate pair; see ID conventions in docs/ROADWATCH_CORRIDOR_MAPPING.md.

project_id.description: Roadway project id (FK to the infrastructure project row / STIP-TIP project).

project_name.description: Project name as stated by the source.

segment_uid.description: RoadWatch segment_uid the project is joined to (FK to roadwatch_segment).

route_id.description: Route identifier the project references, e.g. PR-52.

km_start.description: Optional project extent start station in kilometres along the route LRS. Absent for methods without a project extent (route_only_promoted, nbi_structure_point); leave blank in those rows.

km_end.description: Optional project extent end station in kilometres along the route LRS. Absent for methods without a project extent (route_only_promoted, nbi_structure_point); leave blank in those rows.

overlap_pct.description: Percent of the segment length covered by the project extent, in [0-100] as a string; primary QA metric.

join_method.description: How the join was made: route_km_measure | spatial_overlay | route_only_promoted | nbi_structure_point | manual. See docs/ROADWATCH_CORRIDOR_MAPPING.md vocabulary.

geo_reason_code.description: Reason/quality code for the spatial resolution. Follows the geo_reason_codes row shape (schemas/geo_reason_codes.schema.json). The RoadWatch codes roadwatch_route_km_overlap and roadwatch_route_only_no_km are registered in GEO_RESOLUTION_REASONS (scripts/run_contract_finance_geo_reasoning.py) and appear in the reference table regenerated by scripts/build_geo_reason_codes.py and asserted by tests/test_gis_layers.py. nbi_structure_point is not yet registered: the NBI snapping logic is not implemented, so no producer emits it.

Cell_ID.description: Puerto Rico baseline grid Cell_ID the join resolves to. Empty until the spatial join is computed; required-non-empty for cross-repo promotion.

funding_program.description: Federal funding program, e.g. STBG, NHPP, HSIP, BRIDGE, ER, CDBG-DR.

amount.description: Project or line amount as stated by the source.

confidence.description: Join confidence in [0-1] as a string; combines overlap_pct, join_method, and source tier.

review_status.description: accepted | pending | rejected. Candidates start pending (manual_review_required).

raw_text_excerpt.description: Verbatim source snippet supporting the join.
